title: FrameSpec (H1 frame F, frozen at F4b)
description: Matches the FrameSpec interface in packages/interfaces/src/records.ts (PLAN Appendix, 3.1, 5.7). Written by 'pnpm fiks frame-k --records <dir>' (DET) to paper/prereg/frame-spec.json before F4b. Every field is required and no other field is allowed. Semantic checks (N_E = eligible entities, K = cells, m rule, attribution of every eligible input) are in paper/prereg/lib/frame-spec.ts.

domain.description: Domain ids covered by the frame (shop, tracker).

eligibleInputs.description: Ids (EnumRow dedupe keys) of the FP-eligible inputs.

entities.description: Every extended-catalog entity in the frame, eligible or not.

NE.description: N_E: the number of FP-eligible entities.

attribution.description: inputId -> concrete property path (e.g. items[2].price) -> originUnit (Domain.originEntity).

families.description: property id -> family (last non-index segment of the property path; PLAN 4 D12).

K.description: Number of (property x entity class) cells.

entailedProps.description: Truth-entailed properties (sanity check only, never counted).

crit.description: Critical value crit(N_E, 0.02, alpha) of the one-sided exact binomial test; -1 when no X can reject (N_E < 217).

hash.description: sha256 of the pre-F4b frame CallRecord set ('pnpm fiks record --frame --monitor none'); the F4b ledger entry's frameRecordsSha256 equals it.

neRule.description: Outcome of the N_E rule (PLAN 3.1): catalog top-up batches added, the underpowered flag, and m (3 if N_E < 217, else 4).
